subject: Model mix & token volumes — pricing follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@brightlayer.com>; BrightLayer Product Team <product@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: model mix, token volumes & next steps

Hi Liam / BrightLayer team,

Great to speak this morning — thanks for walking through the integration and the high-level roadmap. Quick recap and the asks we agreed on so we have alignment: 

1) Use case & model mix (what you said):
- Chat (customer support assistant, multi-turn): primary workload, conversational generation.
- Embeddings (semantic search & similarity): used for knowledge retrieval and recommendations.
- Rerank (search result reordering, short-context): small but latency-sensitive.

2) Estimated monthly token volumes (your initial estimates):
- Chat (gpt-chat style): ~50M tokens/month
- Embeddings (512-d vectors, batching): ~10M tokens/month
- Rerank (short queries): ~2M tokens/month
- Total ~= 62M tokens/month (month-to-month variability expected)

3) Budget and unit economics target:
- You mentioned a target of ~$300–$400 per 1M tokens (all-in hosted) as a ballpark for first-year pricing.
- You also called out interest in reserved capacity if the economics improve meaningfully.

4) Questions / data items we requested:
- Confirm expected % split across the three models over the next 6 months (helps with model mix pricing).
- A sample token usage export (last 30 days) or representative logs if possible — attachment stub in case you want to share.
- Procurement timeline and any SSO/contract constraints.

Next steps from Redwood:
- I’ll put together a pricing options summary (hosted vs dedicated) with per-model unit prices and an example effective $/1M based on your mix.
- Attach a preliminary token-volume workbook and a draft SOW for your legal/procurement to review (see attachments).
- Schedule a short demo of Redwood Optimize to show batching/kv caching impact on unit cost (15–20m).

Can you confirm the monthly volume splits and whether the $300–$400/1M target is workable? If you prefer, we can run a quick sensitivity table during the demo.

Thanks,
—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0162
[Attachment: BrightLayer_token_report.xlsx]
[Attachment: SOW_draft_BrightLayer_2026-07.pdf]

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightLayer Product Team <product@brightlayer.com>; Procurement <procurement@brightlayer.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: model mix, token volumes & next steps

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A few clarifications: 

- Volumes: the estimates are correct for the initial pilot. We expect growth to ~120M tokens/month if the pilot hits OKR targets by Q4. For now please price to the pilot numbers (50 / 10 / 2).
- Budget: our procurement partner listed a target of $350 / 1M tokens (hosted, all-in) as the threshold to move forward without a committed contract. If we do a 12-month committed deal we could likely go for a lower effective rate.
- SLA: latency for rerank must be <120ms P95; we might need dedicated capacity for that workload depending on model selection.
- Timeline: procurement will review SOW next week; target for decision mid-August.

Happy to share a token export. Is CSV fine? I’ll ask prod to generate and send to you.


Liam O'Connor
Head of Product, BrightLayer
liam@brightlayer.com
[Attachment: —]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@brightlayer.com>
Cc: BrightLayer Product Team <product@brightlayer.com>; Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>; Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: model mix, token volumes & next steps

Perfect — thanks for the detail, Liam. Attached is a short pricing summary and an illustrative cost table. Main points up front: 

Hosted (no commit) — example per-model unit pricing (per 1M tokens, hosted):
- Chat (gpt-chat variant): $420 / 1M tokens
- Embeddings (embed-v1): $240 / 1M tokens
- Rerank (rerank-small): $680 / 1M tokens (latency-sensitive execution path)

Using your pilot mix (50 / 10 / 2 => weighted average):
- Effective hosted cost: ~$390 / 1M tokens (all-in)

Dedicated (12-mo commit) — example discounted per-model unit pricing:
- Chat: $320 / 1M
- Embeddings: $180 / 1M
- Rerank: $480 / 1M
- Effective with pilot mix: ~$310 / 1M tokens

Notes:
- Rerank is the most expensive per-token due to low-length, low-batch, p95 latency path — dedicated capacity helps a lot here.
- We can run a quick sensitivity analysis during the demo: if chat grows to 100M tokens/month, effective $/1M falls ~8–12% depending on caching.
- We typically ask for a 12-month commit and a baseline usage SLA for Dedicated. If BrightLayer wants a smaller pilot commit we can propose a hybrid (month-to-month hosted + option to convert to Dedicated at month 3).

Requested next steps (from BrightLayer):
- Share token export CSV (past 30 days) — we’ll run it through our cost model.
- Confirm whether you want us to price for Pilot (no commit) vs 12-month commit.
- If procurement is ready, accept the SOW draft so legal can iterate — I attached SOW & updated pricing sheet.

I’ll tentatively schedule a 20m call next Tue to demo Redwood Optimize’s impact on batching + caching (propose Tue 10am PT). Let me know if that works.

Best,
—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0162
[Attachment: Redwood_pricing_sheet_v3.xlsx]
[Attachment: SOW_draft_BrightLayer_2026-07.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: BrightLayer — pricing ask & strategy (BL-2026-0912)

Folks, quick internal note and ask before I send formal proposal to procurement. 

Recap of external ask:
- Pilot volumes: 50M chat / 10M embed / 2M rerank (~62M total).
- Target threshold: ~$350 / 1M hosted to move forward without commit; will consider 12-mo commit if economics improve.
- Rerank latency requirement might push them to request Dedicated for that workload.

My proposal:
- Offer a two-path commercial: Pilot hosted at listed hosted rates (effective ~$390/1M) but include one-time credit of $20k to bridge to $350 threshold for pilot evaluation.
- Offer 12-mo commit pricing that nets ~20% discount off hosted effective rate (~$310/1M effective as I calculated) if they commit to baseline of 5 GPU equivalents / month (we estimate covers their rerank SLA).
- Approve up to 25% first-year discount if procurement pushes back — want to keep margin but win reference customer. Any objections?

If agreed I’ll send the SOW + commercial sheet and mark the HubSpot opportunity BL-2026-0912 with proposed terms.

Thanks,
Marissa


Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
